lines.text: Why do recyclers pay more for some bottle loads than others?
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈuː ɹᵻsˈaɪklɚz pˈeɪ mˈɔːɹ fɔːɹ sˌʌm bˈɑːɾəl lˈoʊdz ðɐn ˈʌðɚz?

lines.text: Keep clear bottles apart; coloured ones often sell for little.
lines.phonemes: kˈiːp klˈɪɹ bˈɑːɾəlz ɐpˈɑːɹt; kˈʌlɚd wˈʌnz ˈɔfən sˈɛl fɔːɹ lˈɪɾəl.

lines.text: Leave out other trash; buyers grade loads by how much is really PET.
lines.tts: Leave out other trash; buyers grade loads by how much is really P E T.
lines.phonemes: lˈiːv ˈaʊt ˈʌðɚ tɹˈæʃ; bˈaɪɚz ɡɹˈeɪd lˈoʊdz baɪ hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ ɪz ɹˈiəli pˈiː ˈiː tˈiː.

lines.text: Then crush them; loose bottles are mostly air, and air costs transport.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn kɹˈʌʃ ðˌɛm; lˈuːs bˈɑːɾəlz ɑːɹ mˈoʊstli ˈɛɹ, ænd ˈɛɹ kˈɔsts tɹˈænspɔːɹt.

lines.tts: Say four hundred kilos sell for eight thousand eight hundred rupees.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ fˈɔːɹ hˈʌndɹɪd kˈiːloʊz sˈɛl fɔːɹ ˈeɪt θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪt hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz.

lines.text: Buying, transport and labour leave about ₹1,500.
lines.tts: Buying, transport, and labour leave about fifteen hundred rupees.
lines.phonemes: bˈaɪɪŋ, tɹˈænspɔːɹt, ænd lˈeɪbɚ lˈiːv ɐbˌaʊt fˈɪftiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
